outcome: Hospital readmission within 6 weeks of postpartum hospitalization discharge
cohort: Obstetric patients who delivered between March 1, 2017, and February 28, 2021, at 20-44 weeks of gestation and were discharged within 7 days of delivery
finding: Short postpartum hospitalization length of stay was significantly more common during the COVID-19 pandemic for obstetric patients, with no change in hospital readmissions within 6 weeks of postpartum hospitalization discharge.
mod_finding: The increase in short postpartum hospitalizations during the COVID-19 pandemic was observed for both vaginal births and cesarean births.
